journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

articles.title_en: Progressive income taxation and consumption baskets of rich and poor
articles.title_cn: 累进所得税与贫富消费篮子
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, I analyze the implications of differences in consumption baskets across income groups to evaluate the effects of redistributive taxation on efficiency and inequality. To this end, I develop a static multi-sector general equilibrium model incorporating a parametric tax function, non-homothetic consumption preferences, and endogenous labor supply, with varying compositions of skilled and unskilled labor in production across sectors. A calibrated version of the model captures the cross-sectional differences in the compositions of households' consumption baskets in the United States. I find that considering the differences in consumption baskets between high- and low-income households leads to a lower optimal choice of income tax progressivity compared to the conventional approach that ignores this feature of the data.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我分析了不同收入群体消费篮子差异的含义，以评估再分配税收对效率和 inequality 的影响。为此，我构建了一个静态多部门一般均衡模型，该模型包含参数化税收函数、非齐次消费偏好和内生的劳动供给，并且各部门生产中技能与非技能劳动的构成不同。模型的校准版本捕捉了美国家庭消费篮子构成的横截面差异。我发现，与忽略数据这一特征的传统方法相比，考虑高收入和低收入家庭消费篮子的差异会导致所得税累进性的最优选择较低。

articles.title_en: Life cycle insurance, bequest motives and annuity loads
articles.title_cn: 生命周期保险、遗赠动机与年金负担
articles.abstract_en: We investigate insurance purchases when bequest motives are age-varying and life insurance and life annuities both carry loads. The existing life cycle literature assumes bequests are normal goods without being either necessities or luxuries. Much of the literature also assumes implicitly that life annuity loads are negative. A key finding of the literature is that the demand for life insurance and the demand for life annuities are symmetrical. It is optimal to buy life-contingent insurance throughout life, even under loads. A life annuity phase backs directly onto a life insurance phase. We find that realistic examples with positive loads on both products reveal up to two distinct periods of non-participation, one in midlife and the other adjoining the maximum age. We highlight examples with necessity bequests during child-rearing years and luxury bequests thereafter. This set of assumptions explains why a substantial demand for life insurance during child-rearing years can co-exist with negligible demand for life annuities later on. A realistic 18% load on both products generates this outcome.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当遗赠动机随年龄变化且人寿保险与终身年金均带有负担时的保险购买行为。现有生命周期文献假设遗赠是正常品，既非必需品也非奢侈品。大部分文献还隐含假设终身年金的负担为负。文献的一个关键发现是，人寿保险需求与终身年金需求是对称的。即使在有负担的情况下，终身购买生命或有保险也是最优的。终身年金阶段直接衔接人寿保险阶段。我们发现，在两种产品均带有正负担的现实例子中，会出现最多两个不参与时期，一个在中年，另一个紧邻最大年龄。我们强调了在抚养子女期间遗赠为必需品、之后为奢侈品的例子。这一系列假设解释了为何在抚养子女期间对人寿保险的大量需求可以与之后对终身年金的微不足道的需求并存。两种产品上现实中的18%负担产生了这一结果。

articles.title_en: Asset home bias in debtor and creditor countries
articles.title_cn: 债务国与债权国的资产本土偏好
articles.abstract_en: Why do debtor countries have on average a less diversified international portfolio than creditor countries? With two symmetric countries, the existing literature has showed why portfolios are home-biased to the same degree across countries. We show that, in a model with debtor and creditor countries, a new hedging motive of net external positions implies a short (long) position of both home and foreign assets in the debtor (creditor) country. Marginally, the debtor (creditor) country loses (gains) the net foreign asset (NFA) as a diversified portfolio on top of the above symmetrically biased portfolio, which intensifies (dilutes) the home bias there. An extended model with both equity and bond assets also yields global two-way capital flows that are in consistent with the data. The theory helps understand the financial capital flows between the debtor developing and creditor developed countries during the financial globalization from 1990s, and receives empirical support.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么债务国平均而言比债权国拥有更不多样化的国际投资组合？在有两个对称国家的模型中，现有文献已经表明为什么各国投资组合的本土偏好程度相同。我们表明，在包含债务国和债权国的模型中，净外部头寸的新对冲动机意味着债务国（债权国）对本国和外国资产均持有空头（多头）头寸。边际上，债务国（债权国）在上述对称偏好的投资组合之外，失去了（获得了）净外国资产（NFA）作为多样化投资组合的一部分，这加剧了（稀释了）那里的本土偏好。一个同时包含股票和债券资产的扩展模型也产生了与数据一致的全球双向资本流动。该理论有助于理解在1990年以来的金融全球化过程中，债务发展中国家和债权发达国家之间的金融资本流动，并得到了实证支持。

articles.title_en: Underinvestment and optimal capital structure under environmental constraints
articles.title_cn: 环境约束下的投资不足与最优资本结构
articles.abstract_en: We develop a Q-theoretical model for levered firms subject to environmental constraints (regulations). The model highlights the implications of environmental constraints on dynamic investment and optimal capital structure decisions. We find that environmental constraints can lead equityholders to become endogenously risk averse. Moreover, environmental constraints give rise to underinvestment in capital and asset sales, which is attributed to the carbon abatement effect caused by environmental constraints. In addition, firms with environmental constraints use conservative debt for low business risk and choose high leverage for high business risk relative to firms without environmental constraints, which is governed by the trade-off between abatement cost effect and risk-aversion effect caused by environmental constraints. Firms with environmental constraints have high credit spreads. Our theoretical results are consistent with some empirical findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们针对受环境约束（法规）约束的杠杆企业开发了一个Q理论模型。该模型强调了环境约束对动态投资和最优资本结构决策的影响。我们发现，环境约束可能导致股权持有者内生地变得风险厌恶。此外，环境约束导致资本和资产出售方面的投资不足，这归因于环境约束引起的碳减排效应。另外，相对于没有环境约束的企业，有环境约束的企业在低商业风险下使用保守债务，在高商业风险下选择高杠杆，这由环境约束引起的减排成本效应和风险厌恶效应之间的权衡所决定。有环境约束的企业具有较高的信用利差。我们的理论结果与一些实证发现一致。

articles.title_en: Fast estimation of a large TVP-VAR model with score-driven volatilities
articles.title_cn: 带得分驱动波动率的大型TVP-VAR模型的快速估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a fast approach to estimating a large time-varying parameter vector autoregressive (TVP-VAR) model. Based on a score-driven modeling framework, we first assume that the time-varying variances of random errors in each equation of the TVP-VAR are score-driven, and then propose filtering and smoothing procedures to estimate time-varying parameters and time-varying volatilities. We show that under the forgetting factors, the filtering estimation of time-varying parameters is equivalent to an equation-by-equation estimator, significantly reducing the dimension of state space and thus delivering fast estimation. Moreover, a fast smoothing estimation can be derived, avoiding the inverse of the super-high dimensional state equation covariance matrix. We provide dynamic model averaging (selection) and maximum likelihood estimates for forecasting and inference. Our simulation study shows that the proposed method is more accurate than the popular methods and enjoys tremendous computational gain from the equation-by-equation estimator. Finally, we conduct an empirical study on the dynamic connectedness of global stock markets, demonstrating the merits of our methods in real-time and ex-post analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种估计大型时变参数向量自回归（TVP-VAR）模型的快速方法。基于得分驱动建模框架，我们首先假设TVP-VAR中每个方程随机误差的时变方差是得分驱动的，然后提出滤波和平滑程序来估计时变参数和时变波动率。我们表明，在遗忘因子下，时变参数的滤波估计等价于逐方程估计器，显著降低了状态空间的维度，从而实现快速估计。此外，可以推导出快速平滑估计，避免了超高维状态方程协方差矩阵的求逆。我们提供了动态模型平均（选择）和最大似然估计，用于预测和推断。我们的模拟研究表明，所提出的方法比流行方法更准确，并且从逐方程估计器中获得了巨大的计算收益。最后，我们对全球股票市场的动态连通性进行了实证研究，展示了我们的方法在实时和事后分析中的优势。

articles.abstract_en: The 2008 Global Financial Crisis called into question the narrow focus on price stability of inflation targeting regimes. This paper studies the relationship between price stability and financial stability by analyzing alternative monetary policy strategies for an economy that experiences endogenous financial crises due to excessive household sector leverage. We reach three conclusions. First, a central bank can improve both price stability and financial stability by adopting an aggressive inflation targeting regime, in the absence of the zero lower bound (ZLB) constraint on nominal interest rates. Second, in the presence of the ZLB constraint, an aggressive inflation targeting regime may undermine both price stability and financial stability. Third, a leaning against the wind policy can be detrimental to both price stability and financial stability when the credit cycle is driven by countercyclical household sector leverage. In this environment, leaning with credit spreads can be more effective.
articles.abstract_cn: 2008年全球金融危机使通胀目标制对价格稳定的狭隘关注受到质疑。本文通过分析一个因家庭部门过度杠杆而经历内生金融危机的经济体所采取的替代性货币政策策略，研究价格稳定与金融稳定之间的关系。我们得出三个结论。第一，在名义利率不存在零下限约束的情况下，中央银行可以通过采取积极的通胀目标制来同时改善价格稳定和金融稳定。第二，在存在零下限约束的情况下，积极的通胀目标制可能同时损害价格稳定和金融稳定。第三，当信贷周期由逆周期的家庭部门杠杆驱动时，逆风而行的政策可能对价格稳定和金融稳定均不利。在这种环境下，顺应信贷利差的政策可能更为有效。

articles.title_en: Bayesian mixed-frequency quantile vector autoregression: Eliciting tail risks of monthly US GDP
articles.title_cn: 贝叶斯混频分位数向量自回归：揭示美国月度GDP的尾部风险
articles.abstract_en: Timely characterizations of risks in economic and financial systems play an essential role in both economic policy and private sector decisions. However, the informational content of low-frequency variables and the results from conditional mean models provide only limited evidence to investigate this problem. We propose a novel mixed-frequency quantile vector autoregression (MF-QVAR) model to address this issue. Inspired by the univariate Bayesian quantile regression literature, the multivariate asymmetric Laplace distribution is exploited under the Bayesian framework to form the likelihood. A data augmentation approach coupled with a precision sampler efficiently estimates the missing low-frequency variables at higher frequencies under the state-space representation.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济和金融系统中风险的及时刻画在经济政策和私营部门决策中起着至关重要的作用。然而，低频变量的信息含量以及条件均值模型的结果仅为研究这一问题提供了有限的证据。我们提出了一种新颖的混频分位数向量自回归（MF-QVAR）模型来解决这一问题。受单变量贝叶斯分位数回归文献的启发，在贝叶斯框架下利用多元非对称拉普拉斯分布来构建似然函数。一种数据增强方法结合精度采样器，在状态空间表示下高效地估计高频频率下缺失的低频变量。
